messages.subject: [OGRUG] Ottawa R Helpdesk meetings
messages.body_plain:
Greetings Ottawa/Gatineau R users,

I'm a biostatistician with a fair bit of experience in R. A friend of mine
asked me to help him with some code, and while we were talking it over, we
decided to invite the general R-using public to come along. So without
further ado, I introduce the Ottawa R Helpdesk
meetup<http://www.meetup.com/R-Helpdesk/>,
an informal, semi-regular gathering of (at least two) local R users
grappling with the wonders and vagaries of R.

All the best,
Corey
